messages.subject: deducer model explorer: font size
parts:
hi,
I have been using deducer for a while and enjoy it very much.
However, now I have switched to a new laptop with full HD display and a lot of things become simply unreadable. While I can regulate the console font size, I haven't found a way to change the data viewer, model explorer, builder etc. font size. Any suggestions on that?
(I have tried scaling down my screen resolution, but surprisingly that doesn't seem to help either)
Thanks for any hints, best regards,
Theresa

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: deducer model explorer: font size
parts:
The font sizes for those things are not changeable within the program. Additionally you can not change the font size of the GUI buttons and labels. It sounds like this is a global problem for you (not limited to Deducer). I'd try to change your OS settings so that things are readable at reasonable font sizes throughout your system.

ian
